independence: No coordinator repository, condition/role allocation, producer judgment, sibling workset, release decision or other reviewer result was inspected.
isolation_limit: Instruction only on a shared host, not a separate security sandbox.
preservation_rule: Keep initial report and this cohort's records immutable; later anonymous cohorts append to cumulative products without rewriting these judgments. Unblinding and disposition require a separate continuation.
clock_note: UTC timestamps are retained in emitting runtime records; browser display times use application/browser formatting. Only within-run monotonic intervals are compared.
remaining_material_scope: P10 Return to latest during streaming
P13 narrow Evidence ledger table overflow
P16 T1 narrow navigation and representative long-value presentation
test_failure_policy: Sandbox launch and wiki selector failures remain in actual command records; successful follow-ups are separate.
